stewards.name: OpenAI
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 1; runs ChatGPT, the main ACP agent surface. Its merchant page still says ChatGPT shopping is built on ACP, while its developer commerce docs, rewritten on 2026-11-13, and ChatGPT Wallet do not mention ACP (as of 2026-11-21).

stewards.name: Stripe
stewards.role: Founding maintainer, TSC seat 2; co-developer. The ACP website calls Stripe, with its Shared Payment Token, the first compatible PSP (2026-11-21).

stewards.name: Meta
stewards.role: TSC seat 3 since 2026-04-24; CLA signed 2026-03-19. Its shopping agent Muse (2026-09-08) pays through Link, Shop Pay and PayPal, and no Meta or Stripe post on Muse mentions ACP (as of 2026-11-14); Meta develops the Personal Agent Protocol with Sierra.

implementers.name: ChatGPT product discovery (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Agent surface ingesting merchant feeds through ACP, which OpenAI's merchant page still calls the base of ChatGPT shopping (2026-11-21); Target, Sephora, Nordstrom, Lowe's, Best Buy, The Home Depot and Wayfair named on 2026-03-24. Since the 2026-11-13 rewrite OpenAI's docs send businesses to Business Hub to upload full snapshots in OpenAI's own flat feed format, while the merchant page still shows a waitlist and a planned self-serve platform (2026-11-21).

implementers.name: ChatGPT Wallet (OpenAI), not an ACP path
implementers.role: Launched 2026-11-13 in dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers; OpenAI's help article (updated 2026-11-19) says it works only in conversations with a dot. The user approves each purchase in ChatGPT, OpenAI's post says the payment network then provides a payment token that the merchant's existing checkout charges, and the Wallet terms let OpenAI ask a PSP, card network or issuer for the credential. As read 2026-11-21 the post names American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa as partners, with Chase as a card issuer and launch-day coverage naming three, and PSPs including Adyen, Checkout.com and Stripe. OpenAI does not present it as ACP: the merchant receives a network token, and neither the post nor the Accept payments guide names an ACP vault token or an SPT.

implementers.name: ChatGPT plugins (formerly the Apps SDK) external checkout (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Users finish on the merchant's own checkout; generally available, with approval currently limited to plugins for physical goods (2026-10-20, unchanged on 2026-11-21). OpenAI's merchant page says there are no fees for purchases made on the merchant's site or app. OpenAI's commerce plugin guide recommends headless plugins, because iframe-based plugin UI is not supported in dots.

implementers.name: ChatGPT plugins checkout with saved payment methods (OpenAI)
implementers.role: Documented on 2026-10-20 as a third path: the plugin shows only payment methods the customer already saved with the merchant, and the customer confirms in ChatGPT. It cannot collect new credentials, which need the payment sheet. The page gives it no availability label.

implementers.name: ChatGPT payment sheet (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat payment sheet in ChatGPT plugins (formerly the Apps SDK), a private beta for select marketplace partners; PSPs Adyen, Checkout.com, Fiserv, PayPal, Stripe, Worldpay.

implementers.name: ChatGPT Instant Checkout, 2025 form (OpenAI)
implementers.role: In-chat ACP checkout launched with US Etsy sellers on 2025-09-29; scaled back in March 2026. OpenAI's plugin guidelines still list Instant Checkout as a beta for select marketplace partners (2026-11-21), while its rewritten commerce docs no longer describe it; no end date is published.

implementers.name: Stripe (Shared Payment Tokens, Agentic Commerce Suite)
implementers.role: Delegate Payment implementation (SPTs, preview) and the Agentic Commerce Suite for agents (private preview), which Stripe says works across multiple commerce protocols. Stripe keeps a protocol page each for ACP and UCP and names UCP in its seller guides for merchant-run checkout (2026-10-20). Its Link Agent Wallet also issues SPTs, virtual cards and Link Pay Tokens to personal agents such as Muse, outside ACP (2026-11-14).

implementers.name: PayPal
implementers.role: Announced it will adopt ACP and run an ACP server for its merchants; CLA signed 2026-04-16. Its Agent Ready docs list ACP for ChatGPT through Braintree delegated payment tokens, beside two UCP paths (2026-11-14).

implementers.name: Checkout.com
implementers.role: Announced ACP support on 2025-11-25 and documents a delegated payment token for ACP checkout in ChatGPT plugins, cards only; its guide repeats that Instant Checkout is limited to select marketplace partners (2026-11-14).

implementers.name: Worldpay
implementers.role: Calls itself an approved payment partner for OpenAI's Instant Checkout and documents POST /sessions/agentic_commerce/delegate_payment (2026-11-14).

implementers.name: Card networks behind ChatGPT Wallet (American Express, Mastercard, Visa)
implementers.role: OpenAI's post names all three among Wallet's partners, alongside the card issuer Chase (as read 2026-11-21; launch-day coverage named the three networks only), and quotes American Express calling Wallet its first Agentic Commerce Experiences integration (reported). No source names the program that issues Wallet tokens. Mastercard's CEO said on 2026-10-29 that a broader OpenAI partnership includes the use of Agent Pay (reported); Visa announced an OpenAI collaboration under Visa Intelligent Commerce on 2026-06-10. None of these ties Wallet to ACP.

implementers.name: Microsoft Copilot Checkout
implementers.role: Launched 2026-01-08 saying it adopts open standards like ACP; later merchant page requires a UCP-compliant feed.

implementers.name: Walmart
implementers.role: Announced Instant Checkout plans on 2025-10-14. On 2026-03-24 OpenAI said a Walmart app in ChatGPT with account linking, loyalty and Walmart payments was available in web browsers, with iOS and Android to follow; Retail Dive reported the same on 2026-03-25.

implementers.name: Shopify (Shopify Catalog)
implementers.role: Product data reaches ChatGPT through Shopify Catalog with no extra merchant work, and OpenAI's merchant page says Shopify and Etsy catalogs are already integrated. Shopify's Help Center calls its ChatGPT channel a discovery-focused referrer: purchases complete in the store's own checkout, with no fees beyond standard payment processing (2026-11-14). Shopify's Shop.dev (2026-10-28) offers the same catalog and checkout to any agent and names neither ACP nor UCP.

implementers.name: Target app in ChatGPT
implementers.role: OpenAI announced the Target app in ChatGPT on 2025-11-19, launching in beta the following week, with multi-item baskets and checkout through the user's Target account. Target was also named for ACP product discovery on 2026-03-24.

implementers.name: Instacart app in ChatGPT
implementers.role: OpenAI's post of 2025-12-08 calls it the first app to offer checkout directly within ChatGPT, powered by ACP, through OpenAI Instant Checkout after the user signs in with an Instacart account; Instacart's release says Stripe powers the transactions. No 2026 source says whether that in-chat checkout still runs, and OpenAI's merchant page says OpenAI is moving away from a standalone Instant Checkout experience (2026-11-21).

implementers.name: Etsy app in ChatGPT
implementers.role: Reported live in beta on 2026-05-05 (Retail Dive, 2026-05-14, citing Etsy's product chief): users tag Etsy in a prompt and click through to Etsy to buy. Etsy sellers were the first ACP Instant Checkout merchants in 2025; OpenAI's merchant page lists Etsy catalogs as already integrated (2026-10-20).

implementers.name: Corporate CLA signatories (Adyen, Wix, commercetools, OpenCommerce Network, Affirm, Agentic Commerce Inc.)
implementers.role: Contributors under the CLA; signing is not evidence of a live integration.

sdks.name: agentic-commerce-protocol
sdks.note: Unofficial type definitions published by Svix; there is no official ACP SDK.

sdks.name: @agentic-commerce-protocol/specification (package.json only)
sdks.note: Repository validation scripts; not published on npm (404 on 2026-10-11).

sdks.name: acp-sdk
sdks.note: Not ACP: this is IBM's Agent Communication Protocol SDK. Listed only to prevent confusion.

metrics.caveat: A named list, not a total count.

metrics.definition: Remark attributed to Shopify's president at an investor conference.
metrics.caveat: Reported through trade press; not a primary figure.

metrics.caveat: Context only; not an ACP usage metric.

metrics.definition: OpenAI's own figure in its ChatGPT Wallet post.
metrics.caveat: Context only; not an ACP usage metric, and Wallet is not an ACP path. Compare the launch figure of more than 700 million (2025-09-29).

metrics.definition: No official volume, GMV or merchant count from OpenAI, Stripe or the project; OpenAI's 2026-11-13 Wallet post and rewritten commerce docs publish none either.

costs.value: No fees for purchases made on the merchant's own site or app
costs.whoPays: Nobody beyond the merchant's own PSP fees
costs.caveat: OpenAI's merchant page as read on 2026-10-20, 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-21; the same sentences are in a 2026-04-04 capture. Its FAQ says there are no fees on purchases that start in ChatGPT and that OpenAI is moving away from a standalone Instant Checkout experience, with purchases completed on merchant-owned sites or apps.

costs.item: ChatGPT Instant Checkout platform fee (2025 form)
costs.value: "A small fee on completed purchases"; no rate published
costs.caveat: OpenAI's wording at the 2025-09-29 launch; free for users. History: the in-chat Instant Checkout was scaled back in March 2026, and OpenAI's merchant page now says there are no fees for purchases completed on the merchant's own site or app (2026-10-20).

costs.item: Reported fee for Shopify merchants on ChatGPT checkout sales (2026-01-21)
costs.value: 4 percent of the sale, on top of Shopify fees
costs.caveat: History: PYMNTS relaying The Information and a Shopify spokesperson in January 2026; not published by OpenAI, and the in-chat checkout it referred to was scaled back in March 2026. The same report said Google and Microsoft charged no extra fee for now. Shopify's Help Center now says there are no fees for selling in ChatGPT beyond standard payment processing (2026-11-21).

costs.item: ChatGPT Wallet purchases (not an ACP path)
costs.value: No Wallet fee stated by OpenAI; CNBC reports OpenAI is not taking a cut of transactions to start
costs.caveat: OpenAI's Wallet post, Wallet help article and Accept payments guide name no fee; the merchant's existing checkout charges the network token, so its normal card processing costs apply. The no-cut statement comes from CNBC, not from an OpenAI page.

costs.value: Set per Participating Channel in Shopify Admin; the terms print no rate
costs.caveat: Shopify's Agentic Storefronts Supplemental Terms (last updated 2026-10-06), section 6.1: Shopify may assess a fee for certain channels, on top of subscription and transaction fees, collected by the payment processor. The terms do not say which channels carry a fee.

costs.value: No protocol fee; Apache-2.0; no fee for TSC or working group seats
costs.caveat: Costs come from platforms and PSPs, not the spec.

costs.value: 0.15 USD per SPT issued (Stripe's US pricing page)
costs.whoPays: Not stated; Stripe prices it per SPT issued
costs.caveat: Listed since at least 2026-04-23, the first archived copy that shows it. The pricing page does not name the party billed; its Learn more link opens the agent variant of the SPT docs, which still carry preview terms (API version 2026-09-30.preview) and show no price. Stripe's Canadian pricing page lists CA$0.20 per SPT issued (2026-10-21).
Card economics are unchanged because the merchant charges the payment; OpenAI's Accept payments guide says the merchant's own checkout processes the payment.
